name: Algebraic Maximum Sum Masking
description: Replaces the standard sum of squared differences with a sum of a polynomial $3(x+y)-2xy$. For $x, y \in \{1, 2\}$, this polynomial evaluates to 4 if $x=y$ and 5 if $x \neq y$. The global sum target of $5m$ can therefore only be achieved if every single edge evaluates to 5, implicitly forcing $x \neq y$ for all edges. This breaks direct pattern-matching on standard bipartite coloring formulations while preserving exact mathematical equivalence.
